column1: # The gate self-tests (fast-gate.test.sh 9f/9g) consume the coverage contract, so a contract
# edit must re-run them. The literal row wins over the !.fleet/** exemption below because
# suite selection is consulted before exemptions (leviroutes-jo7).
# Changed spec/*.spec.mjs|*.spec.js files with no row map to themselves inside fast-gate.sh.
# An explicit row for a spec file OVERRIDES that self-map (fast-gate.test.sh 3e), so a spec
# row here is live config, not dead shorthand for the built-in rule.
# Retired paths (SpecRunner.html, lib/, tests/) deliberately have no rows: nothing exists there, so
# a change under them must fail loudly as 'unmapped' rather than select unrelated suites
# (leviroutes-62g). The gate enforces that a row never outlives its path.
